title: [Master]-Performance issue when calculating the VAT advance return / VAT statement (Base Application, German environment) - Copy
summary: A performance issue with VAT advance return and VAT statement calculations in German environments is addressed by adding keys to the VAT Entry table.
key_points: Keys added to VAT Entry table in both CH (Swiss) and DACH (German) layers
Improves query performance for VAT statement calculations
No behavior changes for users or extensions
